evidence.claim: NORD provides medication, financial assistance with insurance premiums and co-pays, diagnostic testing assistance, and travel assistance for clinical trials or consultation with disease specialists.
TotalAssist is the nation's most comprehensive charitable patient financial assistance program covering nearly 150 serious and chronic conditions, providing grants for out-of-pocket healthcare costs.

The VAA Patient Medical Travel Grant is designed to help ease the financial burden for families who must travel to receive specialized medical care for a vascular anomaly or related syndrome, allocating funds quarterly to help individuals or families travel to appointments or procedures.
Modest Needs offers Self-Sufficiency Grants to assist individuals and families facing temporary financial crisis with one or two lost paychecks away from financial catastrophe.
Help Hope Live provides medical fundraising assistance and guides for healthcare expenses, including support for people with Ehlers-Danlos Syndrome facing catastrophic illness or medical expenses.
